name: PVTA Fare-Free Buses and Vans (FY27)
description: PVTA is fare-free for FY27: no fares or passes are needed for fixed-route buses or vans. Premium service (B79) is not included. Amherst is one of PVTA's 24 member communities.

requirements.text: PVTA is Fare-Free for FY27. No fares or passes needed for fixed-route buses. Does not include premium service (B79).
Service is in PVTA's 24 member communities, which include Amherst.

ways.title: Just get on
ways.detail: No pass, card or sign-up. Board any regular PVTA bus.

ways.detail: PVTA Customer Service, 413-781-7882, Monday to Friday, 9am to 4:45pm.

first_step.title: Ride PVTA buses for free
first_step.detail: No fares or passes are needed for buses and vans this year, except the B79 premium service.
